get_config.description: Admin, pause flag, Ink and Shop addresses, limits and counters

get_story.description: One story. An unknown id returns an empty record (status 0).

get_segment.description: One segment (story id + sequence number, starting at 1)

get_segments.description: Up to 10 segments starting at seq `start`, and fewer when their text passes about 64 KB (at least one). `next` says where to go on.

get_contributor_total.description: Live Ink-backed characters of one author in one story

get_surviving_total.description: Surviving characters after the final edit (credits and Contributor Editions)

is_editor.description: Whether an account is an editor of a story

is_allowed.description: Whether an account is on a story's allow-list

get_invite.description: One invite (only the public address of its link key is stored)

get_trial_used.description: Lifetime trial characters a wallet has written

get_open_count.description: Active projects (OPEN, LOCKED or EDITING) a wallet has opened

get_opener_stories.description: Story ids opened by an account (index from 0, up to 50)

get_category_stories.description: Story ids ever placed in a category (index from 0, up to 50). Check each story's current categories.

get_author_segments.description: Segments written by an account (index from 0, up to 50)

has_reported.description: Whether a wallet has already reported a part

get_account_status.description: Whether a wallet is blocked and how many takedowns it has

get_open_multiplier.description: Price multiplier for this wallet's next story (1 = normal; doubles per open project beyond the normal-price number)

get_terms_accepted.description: Latest Terms of Use version a wallet accepted (0 if never)

quote_cost.description: Exact Ink the contract would charge for this text. Fails with the reason if the text is not allowed.

open_story.description: Open a Book, Short Story or Poem. Pays the open fee through Shop (which mints starter Ink), then burns Ink for the opening text.

update_story.description: Opener changes title, categories, visibility and free chapters (send all of them)

set_editor.description: Opener adds or removes an editor (max 10)

set_allowed.description: Opener or editor adds or removes wallets on the allow-list (max 20 per call)

create_invite.description: Opener creates an invite link: the PUBLIC address of a fresh link key, a use limit and an expiry

join_with_invite.description: A wallet joins a story's allow-list with a signed invite link.

contribute.description: Add text to an OPEN story. Burns exactly expected_ink from the author.

revise_part.description: Change (or, with empty text, remove) someone else's part of an OPEN story. Price: the letters

get_versions.description: A part's kept versions, oldest first, at most 5 per call and only as many as fit about 64 KB of

get_changers.description: Every wallet other than the writer that changed a part (a paid change, the final edit or a

set_story_summary.description: The opener, an editor or a current writer of the story updates "the story so far" while it is

edit_segment.description: The part's own writer edits it in an OPEN story. Rewording is free; letters beyond the part's

remove_segment.description: The part's writer removes it from an OPEN story for free. The opener or an editor may remove a part

top_up_fund.description: Opener adds Ink to a private story's fund (burned from the opener now; unused Ink comes back at the end)

set_segment_hidden.description: Admin or the moderator hides or unhides a part. Works at any stage. Hidden parts

set_citation.description: The part's writer, the opener or an editor sets or changes the part's source note (citation).

set_reading_place.description: A reader saves their place in a story (their bookmark), so it follows their wallet to any device. Not while paused.

get_reading_place.description: A reader's saved place in one story (seq 0 if none).

get_reading_places.description: A reader's saved places, newest story first is NOT guaranteed; index from 0, up to 50.

set_source_note.description: Admin or moderator (the copy checker) notes where parts of a text also appear, without hiding it.

restore_segment.description: The story's opener or an editor brings back a part that was hidden (not one taken down).

takedown_segment.description: Admin removes a part's text for good, at any stage. No Ink refund.

report_segment.description: Any wallet reports a part of a story that is not finalized, once per part. Reports from wallets that

replace_pdf.description: Admin publishes a new book link and text hash after a takedown in a finalized story (the contract does not

close_story.description: Opener closes the story for free and starts the final edit

request_admin_finalize.description: Opener turns the "admin, please finalize" request on or off

advance_final_cursor.description: Anyone may fold up to 50 removed segments into the final edit's

admin_take_over.description: Admin takes over the final edit (opener asked, or opener inactive for inactivity_days, not counting

submit_final_batch.description: Finalizer submits the next final-edit results, in order (max 20 items, 20,000 Ink units of text)

finalize.description: Finalizer stores the PDF link and hash once every segment is processed

archive_if_stale.description: Anyone archives an OPEN story when neither its text nor its opener has been active for the archive

revive.description: Opener revives an archived story once, for free, while their next open project would still be at the

set_addresses.description: Set the Ink and Shop contract addresses. Each can be set once and never changed (AB-037, AB-050).

set_limits.description: Set the adjustable limits, each inside its hard-coded bounds

add_category.description: Add a category (1-32 characters). Returns its id.

set_category_active.description: Turn a category on or off for new picks

set_paused.description: Pause or unpause Stories. While paused, every user write fails, and so do admin_take_over and archiving;

set_moderation.description: Set the moderator (empty turns it off) and how many writer reports hide a part (1 to 20)

set_blocked.description: Admin blocks or unblocks a wallet from opening, writing and reporting

set_terms.description: Publish a new Terms of Use version (must be higher than the current one)

set_admin.description: Propose a new admin. Nothing changes until that address calls accept_admin (two steps, so a typo cannot strand admin). Proposing the current admin cancels.

accept_admin.description: The proposed admin takes over. Must be signed by the proposed address and called directly.

set_min_contribution.description: Set the shortest allowed new text (1 to 200 Ink units). Starts at 20.
